scope: Exact complete video edit for an existing work. The published YouTube ID continues to identify the work and its scores.
originalEvidence: Original public YouTube search result must expose the exact catalogue video ID, its title and displayed duration. Compare its three distinct publisher preview images, hq1.jpg, hq2.jpg, hq3.jpg.
mirrorEvidence: Match a published RUTUBE item with an embeddable HTTPS identity, public allowed playback and an unencrypted timeline. Compare displayed original duration to mirror duration and scan the full publicly offered comparison rendition at 3 fps for the three independently distributed preview images. Refine near matches at 24 fps where needed. Colour comparison on 36 by 20 pixels trims letterboxing. Require channel mean error <=22 and correlation >=0.90 at separated content positions, plus a listed HD rendition. Check upload labels for conflicting language, edition and branded credit information. A mirrored edit with an unresolved alternate-language soundtrack or a conflicting credit remains in review. Signed stream URLs and video segments are not part of the distributed site.
comparisonLimits: Source identity and edit checks use original ID, title, edition credits, duration, and three image samples at distinct times. Browser tests directly observe decoded dimensions and progress under mute. The audio tracks were not compared sample by sample.
playbackEvidence: A frozen Codex in-app browser receipt records mute, at least one second of progress, decoded HD dimensions and matching duration for the exact work and public player. Audio samples were not compared.
